evidence: Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label and modifies src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp to surface internal I/O errors and check block availability.
rationale: RPC and REST endpoints previously misreported confirmed transactions as missing when underlying reads failed due to disk errors or block pruning. As noted in doc/release-notes-35728.md, endpoints like getrawtransaction and /rest/tx now distinguish un-downloaded or pruned blocks from missing transactions and surface internal errors rather than returning empty results.
